players.product: coherent optical transport & data-center interconnect systems (Infinera ICE coherent engines)

quarterly_data.signal: Network Infrastructure FY2025 (20-F): net sales EUR 7 986 million, up 23% from EUR 6 518 million (Americas EUR 3 688 million, up 35%); gross margin 41.1%; operating profit EUR 780 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Network Infrastructure net sales EUR 7 986 million (+23%); Americas +35%

quarterly_data.signal: Customers (20-F): net sales to AI & Cloud and Mission Critical Enterprise & Defense customers were EUR 3 085 million in 2025, up 42% from EUR 2 180 million; telecom providers EUR 15 313 million (up 2%). Nokia states that 9/10 of the top global hyperscalers use Nokia's optical networks and that it has 100+ AI & Cloud customer relationships; it puts the AI & Cloud serviceable addressable market at EUR 17 billion, up 28% year-on-year. In 2025, 2024 and 2023 no single customer represented more than 10% of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: AI & Cloud and MCE&D net sales EUR 3 085 million (+42%); 9/10 top hyperscalers; no customer above 10%

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog and capex (20-F): group order backlog EUR 19.5 billion at end-2025 (EUR 20.0 billion at end-2024); management estimates 57% will be recognized as revenue within 1 year, 28% in 2-3 years and 15% after more than 3 years. Capital expenditure was EUR 606 million in 2025 (EUR 472 million in 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: order backlog EUR 19.5 billion; 57% within 1 year; capex EUR 606 million (2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Own manufacturing capacity (20-F, as of 31 December 2025): Sunnyvale, California compound semiconductor wafer fab and test facility with 2 300 m2 productive capacity, and Allentown, Pennsylvania production and development of advanced packaging and test of photonic integrated circuits with 2 400 m2; base station plants in Oulu, Finland (11 500 m2) and Chennai, India (15 500 m2).
quarterly_data.figure: Sunnyvale compound semiconductor fab 2 300 m2; Allentown PIC packaging and test 2 400 m2
